🚀 Key Account Executive (Outbound) (m/w/d) – Berlin (Vor Ort)
Bereit für den nächsten Schritt im Vertrieb bei einem der am schnellsten wachsenden FinTechs weltweit?
Werde Teil unseres ambitionierten Teams in Berlin und unterstütze kleine Unternehmen im gesamten DACH-Markt mit modernen Payment- und POS-Lösungen.
Bei SumUp verfolgen wir eine klare Mission: Wir helfen kleinen Unternehmen dabei, erfolgreich zu sein, indem wir Zahlungen einfach, zugänglich und unkompliziert machen.
Heute unterstützen wir bereits über 4 Millionen Händler in mehr als 30 Ländern – und wir wachsen weiter.
Als Account Executive (Outbound) übernimmst du den gesamten Sales Cycle und baust aktiv unseren Outbound-Vertrieb in Deutschland mit auf.
Du konzentrierst dich auf etablierte kleine Unternehmen (Upmarket SMBs) mit einem monatlichen Zahlungsvolumen von über 15.000 € und arbeitest als vertrauenswürdiger Berater, nicht als klassischer Produktverkäufer.
Diese neu geschaffene Position bietet dir die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Prozesse mitzugestalten und den deutschen Markt aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.
🎯 Deine Aufgaben
Verantwortung für den gesamten Sales Cycle – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.
Proaktive Neukundengewinnung über Cold Calls, E-Mails und soziale Netzwerke.
Eigenständige Betreuung deines Vertriebsgebiets inklusive Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalyse.
Aufbau und Pflege einer hochwertigen Sales Pipeline.
Durchführung strukturierter Discovery- und Beratungsgespräche, um die Anforderungen der Kunden zu verstehen und passende Payment-, POS- und Kiosklösungen zu empfehlen.
Durchführung überzeugender Produktpräsentationen und Demos.
Souveräner Umgang mit Einwänden sowie Gespräche auf Entscheider- und Geschäftsführerebene.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams wie Sales Enablement und Product.
Analyse deiner Performance, Erreichen deiner Ziele und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung anhand von Daten und Feedback.
Aktive Mitgestaltung einer leistungsorientierten Outbound-Vertriebskultur in unserem Berliner Büro.
👀 Das bringst du mit
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Outbound-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SMB- oder Upmarket-SMB-Umfeld.
Nachweisbare Erfolge im Full-Cycle Sales mit eigener Umsatzverantwortung.
Erfahrung in der Kaltakquise, Leadgenerierung und dem Aufbau einer Sales Pipeline.
Beratungsorientierter Vertriebsansatz sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexere Kundenanforderungen zu verstehen und passende Lösungen zu entwickeln.
Deutsch auf C2- oder muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.
Ausgeprägte Eigenmotivation, Hunter-Mentalität und hohe Eigenverantwortung.
Begeisterung für Technologie, Payment-Lösungen und die Zusammenarbeit mit Unternehmern.
💥 Das bieten wir dir
Attraktives Fixgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provision – dein Erfolg bestimmt dein Einkommen.
Die Möglichkeit, bei einem schnell wachsenden globalen FinTech echten Einfluss zu nehmen.
Eine Office-First-Kultur in unserem Berliner Büro mit einem motivierten und internationalen Team.
2.000 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget für Kurse, Zertifizierungen und Workshops.
30 Tage Sabbatical nach drei Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit.
Ein diverses und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem unterschiedliche Perspektiven geschätzt werden.
Ein attraktives Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprogramm.
Bereit für den nächsten Schritt?
Wenn du im Outbound-Vertrieb erfolgreich sein möchtest, gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Teil eines schnell wachsenden FinTechs werden willst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
Bewirb dich jetzt und wachse gemeinsam mit SumUp in Berlin.
Job Application Tip
We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

Remote- MD, VA & DC Thales is hiring an experience Territory Sales Manager (TSM) will be responsible for managing a territory and maximizing revenue for Thales products. Tasked with detecting and creating new opportunities for assigned region as well as generating accurate and realistic sales forecasts.

The TSM is expected to deliver consistent revenue performance, as well as growth, and will need to opportunistically look at the market for breakout revenue opportunities. Revenue responsibility can range $1M - $2M annually.

Key Areas of Responsibility Manages, develops and grows strategic prospects and existing customer relationships Identifies, qualifies and quantifies all opportunities within an assigned region and leads sales effort Develops and delivers accurate and technically correct sales presentations to potential customers Manages all aspects of the sales cycle including prospecting, development of the customer relationship at all levels and the implementation of the account plans Delivers on set objectives to achieve revenue and growth targets.

Works with sales support staff, pre and post sales staff to further customer relationships forecast, track territory opportunities, and close the deal Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing or Engineering or another related field of study or equivalent work experience 3+ years of experience in Sales within IT industry including, but not limited to inside sales Prior experience selling software products and/or subscription selling working directly with F2000 accounts Experience in managing all aspects of the sales cycle, including prospecting, developing the customer relationship at all levels and the implementation of the account plans Experience working with multi-element revenue models, which include both one time and recurring revenue streams, which may include multiple products Capable of closing complicated deals from discovering sales opportunities to contract completion Able to up-sell existing accounts as well as proactively identify and acquire new customers Comfortable being an active participant (not necessarily leader) in highly technical discussions Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer at the time of hire.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or for assuming sponsorship of an employment visa now or in the future. If you’re excited about working with Thales , but not meeting the requirements for this position, we encourage you to join our Talent Community! https://careers.thalesgroup.com/global/en/jointalentcommunity .

You can upload your CV and our recruiters can get in touch with any new opportunities that may be of interest to you. Why Join Us? Say HI and learn more about working at Thales click here This position will require successfully completing a post-offer background check.

Qualified candidates with criminal history will be considered and are not automatically disqualified, consistent with applicable federal law, state law (the California Fair Chance Act), and local ordinances (San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and Los Angeles County’s Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers).

We are an equal opportunity employer, including disability and veteran status. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you need an accommodation or assistance in order to apply for a position with Thales , please contact us at talentacquisition@us.thalesgroup.com .

Categoria: Comercial Localização: VAGA ABERTA Você é apaixonado por vendas, tecnologia e quer fazer parte de um time que está transformando o mercado de soluções em TI? Estamos fortalecendo nosso time comercial com profissionais que tenham perfil consultivo, organização e foco em resultados.

Buscamos um(a) Account Manager com visão de mercado e alta capacidade de execução para liderar o desenvolvimento e a consolidação de parcerias B2B.

Sua missão principal será a prospecção ativa e a conversão de novos negócios, posicionando o portfólio ManageEngine como o motor de eficiência para infraestrutura e segurança de TI em contas estratégicas.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições Expansão de Mercado: Identificar e prospectar novas oportunidades de alto valor, mapeando decisores e influenciadores no cenário B2B.

Venda Consultiva: Atuar como um conselheiro estratégico, traduzindo necessidades técnicas complexas em soluções de negócio tangíveis, garantindo que o cliente perceba o valor real das ferramentas ManageEngine.

Gestão de Ciclo de Vendas: Gerenciar todas as etapas do funil de vendas, desde a abordagem inicial e diagnóstico até a negociação comercial e o fechamento de contratos robustos.

Relacionamento de Longo Prazo: Cultivar e expandir relacionamentos em contas estratégicas, visando não apenas a venda pontual, mas o crescimento da conta e a fidelização do cliente através de um atendimento de excelência.

Inteligência Competitiva: Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências de TI e o ecossistema de soluções ManageEngine para superar a concorrência e oferecer o melhor custo-benefício aos clientes. O que esperamos de você Mentalidade orientada a resultados ( hunter ) e habilidade comprovada em vendas complexas (B2B).

Excelente capacidade de comunicação e oratória para apresentações executivas. Perfil analítico para diagnosticar dores operacionais e sugerir melhorias baseadas no portfólio de soluções.

Responsabilidades Gerenciar e desenvolver um portfólio de clientes ManageEngine, garantindo relacionamento de longo prazo e alto nível de satisfação; Atuar como ponto focal entre cliente e times técnico, pré-vendas e comercial; Entender o cenário do cliente e propor evolução do ambiente com foco em tecnologia e segurança; Apoiar clientes na adoção e maturidade das soluções ManageEngine; Acompanhar indicadores de sucesso, retenção e expansão da carteira; Trabalhar em conjunto com implantação, suporte e pré-vendas para garantir jornada eficiente; Manter o CRM atualizado com informações estratégicas.

O que oferecemos Atuação com soluções líderes globais em gestão e segurança de TI; Ambiente colaborativo, com autonomia e visão estratégica; Acesso a treinamentos e certificações ManageEngine; Oportunidade real de crescimento (Key Account / Especialista / Liderança); Participação em campanhas e projetos estratégicos.

Obrigatórios Experiência prévia como Account Manager, Customer Success ou Executivo de Contas em tecnologia; Vivência com clientes B2B (preferencialmente SaaS / TI / segurança); Comunicação consultiva e habilidade de conduzir reuniões executivas; Organização, visão analítica e foco em expansão de contas.

Desejáveis Experiência com soluções ManageEngine; Vivência com vendas recorrentes (subscription / licenciamento); Inglês intermediário; Experiência com CRM (Zoho será diferencial).

Do you love to dine out? Are you passionate about helping restaurant owners succeed? Our mission at Yelp is to connect people with great local businesses, and that starts with people like you. Yelp Reservations and Yelp Waitlist are powerful tools that reach and engage diners with an unforgettable experience on the largest restaurant discovery platform in the world.
The Yelp Restaurants division is growing, and we’d love to have you join us. As an Account Executive, you will help lay the groundwork and foundation that will lead to the long-term success of this department. You’ll have the opportunity to run the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing, and everything in between.

At Yelp, you chart the course, and we’ll guide you there. As you progress in your career, you will unlock increased compensation, title, and responsibilities to keep you moving in the right direction.
Yelp is where you can be part of an empowering mission and build a rewarding career that grows with you. Yelp is powered by a global community of collaborative people with shared values. We’re tenacious individuals who believe in our mission to connect people to great local businesses.

Yelp is a remote workplace where your work makes a difference, where you are seen as a whole person, and where you will grow with our support and guidance. If you’re looking for a career (not a job) with a company that is invested in you as a whole person, from personal development, compensation, training, and more, we know just the place.

Manage your own book of business through prospecting & disciplined pipeline management
Drive the full sales cycle primarily through inside sales: make introductory calls, assess business goals through qualifying, and close the deal
Become an expert in Yelp’s full suite of products: Yelp Reservations, Waitlist, Connect and Advertising, and understand the value proposition for each
Be knowledgeable of other restaurant solutions available in the market that help restaurant owners grow their business
Adapt product recommendations quickly to suit the client needs - asking probing questions and handling objections will be critical to your success
Achieve and consistently exceed monthly sales goals

Hold Bachelor’s degree and/or 18 months or more of outbound sales experience
Have experience with restaurant technology (reservation systems, waitlist systems, front-of-house mgmt tools) is a plus
Have excellent communication skills - no fear of the phone
Have general computer and email proficiency, experience with Salesforce is a plus
Have a positive attitude and a drive to win
Have the ability to effectively prioritize tasks and manage time within a fast-paced environment

Effective your first day: Full medical, vision, and dental
Mental health support and services via Modern Health15 days PTO (accrual begins on date of hire and increases with 2+ years of tenure thereafter), 12 paid holidays, plus one floating holiday
Up to 14 weeks of parental leave
Monthly wellness subsidy
Flexible spending account
401(k) retirement savings plan
Employee stock purchase plan
Professional development reimbursement
Work from home reimbursement
Compensation base salary is $52,000-$62,000 annually + performance based incentives

Creatio is a global vendor of an agentic CRM & workflow platform with no-code and AI at its core. We help organisations automate customer and operational workflows, achieving the fastest time-to-value and the highest ROI on the market. Millions of workflows run on Creatio daily, supporting thousands of clients in over 100 countries. Genuine care for our clients and partners is at the heart of our DNA.
We’re proud to be recognised by top industry analysts as a  Leader and Strong Performer in multiple Gartner and Forrester reports.
In 2025, Creatio was named to Inc.’s Best Workplaces list,  recognising our commitment to employee wellbeing and a strong workplace culture.

We are seeking a passionate, proactive, and results-driven Account Executive who is excited to contribute to a fast-growing and innovative company. The ideal candidate is someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, embraces challenges as opportunities, and is motivated to bring fresh ideas to the table.
You should be a strong team player with excellent communication skills, eager to learn and grow, and ready to make an impact from day one. Most importantly, we’re looking for individuals who share our values, believe in collaboration, and want to be part of a workplace where creativity, accountability, and ambition are celebrated.

Drive revenue growth by acquiring and nurturing new business opportunities within the UKI territory, focusing on securing major enterprise accounts.
Lead the end-to-end enterprise sales process, from prospecting to closing deals, while managing pipeline, forecasting, and key performance metrics.
Develop and execute winning solution sales strategies tailored to the needs of enterprise clients, collaborating with diverse internal teams.
Cultivate relationships with VP/C-level buyers in both business and IT departments, ensuring alignment with their strategic objectives.
Conduct compelling sales presentations and product demonstrations to showcase the value proposition of the Creatio platform.
Prioritize new logo acquisition while fostering relationships with existing accounts to identify opportunities for expansion.

A minimum of 5+ years of enterprise sales (CRM/BPM or no-code is a bonus) experience, with a proven track record of exceeding quarterly and annual targets.
Deep understanding of enterprise sales methodologies and executive-level selling, particularly within large enterprises.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, along with strong organizational abilities.
Technical curiosity and willingness to learn are essential.
Growth & Development: Clear career paths, mentorship opportunities, and access to continuous learning to help you reach your full potential.
Flexibility & Well-Being : We provide flexible work arrangements and initiatives that empower you to manage your schedule effectively, stay productive, and thrive both personally and professionally.
Recognition & Impact: A culture that celebrates achievements, values your ideas, and empowers you to make real contributions from day one.
Innovative Culture: Be part of a company that embraces new ideas, modern technologies, and bold thinking to stay ahead of the curve.
Benefits & Rewards Package : We provide competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you and your family. Our rewards approach goes beyond salary, recognizing your contributions and commitment. The exact package may vary depending on your country of residence and employment type.

At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally.

Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light.

You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
Enterprise Account Executive - DACH
Why We Have This Role
Qualtrics is on the lookout for a proactive, collaborative seller that can help us lead and own the strategy for selling Experience Management (XM) SaaS within the largest accounts in the DACH market. We’re helping the world’s leading companies improve experiences.

Our solutions allow our clients to have a 360° view of the entire experience enabling them to uncover what matters most to clients and employees with the ability to take action in real time.

In the Enterprise Sales role, you will be working with Major Accounts with an overarching objective to drive company revenue growth through net new customer acquisition and expansion in our current customer base.

This person will work collaboratively to meet sales goals and deliver the highest standard of integrity, quality, and customer service to our clients.
How You’ll Find Success
Relationship Building: Master stakeholder mapping to cultivate relationships with multiple contacts within an account, ensuring lasting partnerships.
Negotiation Skills: Navigate negotiations with professionalism, understanding the art of give-and-take.
Multi-Selling Approach: Drive engagement with various business stakeholders in parallel to create multifaceted selling opportunities.
Empathetic Competitiveness: While being competitive, possess the ability to empathise and understand others’ perspectives.
Entrepreneurial Mindset: Take initiative to grasp the expected outcomes and context, working independently to drive results.
Effective Communication: Influence effectively at all levels, creating trust and collaboration within the team.
How You’ll Grow
By joining Qualtrics, you become part of a revolutionary team committed to shaping groundbreaking experiences.
You will help us expand the XM category beyond where it is today with more advanced use cases & pioneering advancements in AI.
Our mission is to build technology that positively impacts businesses and makes them more human.
As a member of our global sales organisation, you will take ownership of a dedicated territory and develop robust strategies designed to drive demand and revenue.
We foster an environment that encourages big-picture thinking, innovation, and creativity, enabling you to build relationships with multiple decision-makers and articulate the unique value proposition of Qualtrics.
Things You’ll Do
Focus on acquiring new business and sell the Qualtrics Platform to key accounts.
Develop comprehensive account plans, from power maps to demand generation and closing strategies.
Manage relationships between Qualtrics and senior executives of both client and prospect companies.
Strategising internally with SDRs (sales development representatives), solutions consultants, partners etc to create demand and drive senior engagement in accounts.
Gain a thorough understanding of prospects' business issues and industry challenges to craft tailored solutions.
Build compelling business cases that demonstrate clear ROI and value for clients.
Maintaining a real-time understanding of Qualtrics' offerings and the competitive landscape to provide win-based proposals and pricing strategies.

s.h: What We’re Looking For On Your Resume
s.t:
Significant experience selling SaaS solutions, and experience in discussing strategic business issues at Director and C level in Large Enterprise accounts.
Significant demonstrated success in driving and navigating C-level engagement & connections at the highest level.
Significant experience in leading, planning and closing 7 figure deals.
Significant experience in owning the full commercial capacity of Strategic Accounts.
Strong track record in achieving and exceeding sales quotas.
Ability to be creative in driving engagement with new contacts within an account.
Fluency in German and English.
You are passionate about educating potential clients on solutions relevant to their situation and helping them understand how the software can drive a return on investment for them.
You can leverage your network in the market to generate interest in Qualtrics solutions.
You have a desire to manage a territory like running your own consultancy.
You engage with clients at all points of the sales cycle - from prospecting and acquiring clients, through demoing the Qualtrics product, to negotiating and closing, and beyond.
You have the agility to adapt, pivot and change your approach based on the needs of your business.
You partner well with internal teams and bring together internal resources that enable successful closure of deals.
What You Should Know About This Team
Qualtrics global sales team is dedicated to changing the way our customers focus on experiences. Forrester reports that companies generate a 674% return on investment when using Qualtrics. Now that's a solution you can get behind.
As an Enterprise Sales professional, you will focus on new revenue through strategic, relationship-based selling. Our most successful sales employees have a track record of exceeding quotas, acting as trusted advisors to clients and being passionate teammates.
The Qualtrics platform is versatile, adding value to a limitless array of decision makers. If you love a strategic, analytics sales process working with a variety of industries, departments and buyers, selling Qualtrics XM will always keep you learning and growing.
Challenges excite us, as we view them as opportunities for growth and positive transformation.
We are not merely observers of change; we actively initiate and drive it.

s.h: Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits
s.t:
Qualtrics Experience Program - A bonus each year for an experience of your choosing
Worldwide and diverse community that enjoys helping each other
At Qualtrics we are constantly working to create an environment where everyone feels safe and comfortable coming to work and can, as a result of our culture, make their best possible contribution to our team
The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model : While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader.

These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.
Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.
Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.
How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.
We are seeking a gifted and talented Account Excecutive to join our Berlin office.
This role involves engaging qualified strategic prospects, demoing the Aircall solution, providing technical assistance, successfully navigating a proof of concept and negotiating contracts . It is a fast-paced role that fits high energy and smart sales people.

Fluent in German with a full professional proficiency in English.
2 to 5 years of sales experience is mandatory.
Knowledge of sales methodologies such as SPICED / MEDDIC a bonus.
Successful track record of closing net new business and generating your own pipeline through prospection .
A proactive , driven sales approach to identify and communicate business pains and outcomes, drive urgency and take end to end ownership for quota attainment.
Demonstrable organizational and time management skills.
Competitive and driven to achieve goals , build new skills and bring new ideas on how to do things faster and better.

🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey.
We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.
We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn.

Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going

Wir entwickeln und produzieren hochwertige Akustikboxen, die wirklich zu modernen Arbeitswelten passen.
Dabei verkaufen wir nicht einfach nur „Boxen“ – wir verkaufen Fokus, Produktivität und ein besseres Arbeitsumfeld.
Für den DACH-Markt suchen wir einen Full-Cycle BDR , der den gesamten Sales-Prozess selbst in die Hand nehmen möchte – vom ersten „Hallo“ bis zum finalen Handshake.
Die Rolle: Beratung statt einfach nur telefonieren Bei uns liest Du kein vorgefertigtes Skript ab. Du berätst Unternehmen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz dabei, bessere Arbeitswelten zu gestalten.
Qualifizierte Inbound Leads: Vergiss wahlloses „Smile and Dial“. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für hochwertige Leads – Unternehmen, die bereits echtes Interesse an unseren Produkten haben.
Pipeline-Aufbau: Du identifizierst relevante Entscheider:innen wie Facility Manager, HR Leads oder Founder und baust eine Pipeline auf, bei der Qualität wichtiger ist als reine Quantität.
End-to-End Ownership: Du identifizierst potenzielle Kund:innen, führst Discovery Calls und Demos durch und schließt Deine Deals selbst ab. So siehst Du am Ende ganz konkret, wie Deine Arbeit in Form einer mute-labs Box im Büro des Kunden steht.
Kein Ellenbogen-Sales: Bei uns gibt es keine Provision. Warum? Weil wir möchten, dass Du das tust, was für den Kunden und das Team am besten ist – nicht das, was Deinen Bonus maximiert. Stattdessen bieten wir ein wettbewerbsfähiges, stabiles Fixgehalt, weil wir auf Deine intrinsische Motivation setzen.
So könnte Dein Tag bei uns aussehen Wir leben eine Office-First-Kultur . Wir glauben, dass die besten Sales-Ideen bei einem gemeinsamen Kaffee entstehen – und nicht in endlosen Slack-Threads.
09:00 | Morning Vibe: Du kommst in unser energiegeladenes Office in Berlin-Mitte, holst Dir einen Kaffee, checkst die neuesten Leads und planst Deinen Tag.
09:30 | Action Phase: Du bist am Telefon oder im Video-Call, sprichst mit neuen Leads über ihre Office-Herausforderungen und vereinbarst Demos.
11:00 | Strategy Huddle: Kurzer Austausch mit Alvaro, unserem Country Manager, oder Jarno, unserem Sales Director, zu einem konkreten Deal oder einem Markttrend, den Du entdeckt hast.
12:30 | Family Table: Wir essen gemeinsam. Freitags kocht ein Team für die ganze Firma. Ob Pasta, Tacos oder ein persönlicher Klassiker – beim gemeinsamen Mittagessen kommen wir als Team zusammen.
14:30 | Market Mastery: Du führst Discovery Demos. Dabei hörst Du mehr zu, als Du redest, und findest heraus, wo beim Kunden wirklich der Schuh drückt.
18:00 | The Close: Du bringst Dein CRM auf den neuesten Stand, aktualisierst Deine Pipeline und machst Feierabend. Deine Offline-Zeit respektieren wir.
Pulse & Pints Friday Jeden Freitag lassen wir die Woche gemeinsam ausklingen.
The Pulse: In unserem Team-Huddle schauen wir auf die Zahlen, teilen Company Updates und feiern Kolleg:innen, die in dieser Woche besonders viel bewegt haben.
The Pints: Danach starten wir gemeinsam ins Wochenende – mit Drinks, alkoholisch oder 0,0 %, und dem guten Gefühl, gemeinsam etwas erreicht zu haben.
Unser Bewerbungsprozess: Schnell & transparent Wir wissen, dass gute Kandidat:innen gefragt sind – deshalb lassen wir Dich nicht wochenlang warten.
The Spark: Ein kurzer Screening Call mit Lia , um herauszufinden, ob unsere Werte und Vorstellungen zusammenpassen.
The Market Fit: Ein Deep Dive mit Alvaro (Country Manager) und Jarno (Sales Director), bei dem es um Deine Sales-DNA geht.
The Commercial View: Ein Gespräch mit Leah (Head of Commercial) über unsere Wachstumsstrategie und Deine Rolle darin.
The Live Action: Ein Discovery Role Play mit dem Team. Keine Hausaufgabe, keine tagelange Vorbereitung – wir möchten einfach sehen, wie Du ein echtes Kundengespräch führst.
The Vision: Ein finales Gespräch mit unserem CEO , in dem es um das große Ganze und Deine Entwicklung bei mute-labs geht.
Erkennst Du Dich wieder? Self-Driven Hunter: Du brauchst keinen Provisionscheck, um ambitioniert zu bleiben. Du willst Deine Ziele erreichen und das Unternehmen aktiv mit voranbringen.
Native Communicator: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und kannst Dich sicher und überzeugend im DACH-Markt bewegen.
Full-Cycle Mindset: Du magst sowohl den Reiz, neue Leads zu finden, als auch das gute Gefühl, einen Deal selbst zum Abschluss zu bringen.
Team Player: Arbeiten in Silos ist nichts für Dich. Du möchtest Erfolge teilen, voneinander lernen und Deine Kolleg:innen genauso bei ihren Deals unterstützen wie bei Deinen eigenen.
Bereit, mehr Ruhe in die Arbeitswelt zu bringen? Wenn Du nach einer Sales-Rolle suchst, in der Du als Profi behandelt wirst, von einem starken Team unterstützt wirst und in einer offenen, ambitionierten Office-Kultur arbeiten möchtest, dann wollen wir Dich kennenlernen.
Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir melden uns schneller bei Dir, als Du denkst!

Client Partner - Deliveroo for Work
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide.

From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
We’re looking for a Client Partner to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us lead both the acquisition and ongoing management of large, complex global clients, directly shaping how we win, structure, and scale our largest global partnerships.
Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/the-commercial-team/
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Deliveroo for Work (DfW) team. DfW is Deliveroo’s B2B arm, offering simple and flexible food-spending solutions to corporate clients across global markets, from team lunches to office events and pantry supplies.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Own Enterprise Deals: Lead end-to-end sales cycles for high-value, multi-market partnerships with Fortune 500 and large global organisations.
Manage Strategic Accounts: Oversee account management for top global clients, driving contract renewals, retention, and account expansion with senior stakeholders.
Lead and Develop a Team: Manage, coach, and support a small team, setting clear direction to deliver against global enterprise targets.
Design Bespoke Propositions: Craft tailored commercial models, pricing, and rollout strategies that align Deliveroo's capabilities with complex client needs.
Navigate Technical & Product Complexity: Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Legal teams to solve security/compliance requirements and feed customer insights into the product roadmap.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Complex B2B Commercial Experience: Significant track record closing high-value B2B deals and nurturing strategic accounts within complex procurement, legal, and security environments.
People Leadership: Proven ability to manage, coach, and develop a team while balancing hands-on commercial delivery.
Technical & Product Fluency: Ability to engage credibly with Product, Engineering, and Security teams to translate technical constraints into commercial outcomes.
Executive Presence: Exceptional stakeholder management skills with a demonstrated ability to influence C-suite decision-makers across functions.
Strategic & Commercial Judgment: Strong commercial sharpness to structure, negotiate, and execute high-impact global partnerships through long sales cycles.

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.
We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.
Our Global Structure
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

会社概要
BoostDraftは、契約書をはじめとする法的文書の作成・レビューを効率化するプロダクトを開発・提供するリーガルテック企業です。
2021年にMITとStanford大学院の卒業生が創業し、現在6年目を迎えています。プロダクトへの圧倒的な信頼を武器に、口コミを中心に急拡大。創業2年目には純利益1億円を達成するなど、着実に成長してきました。現在は日本の5大法律事務所すべてを含む、国内外800社以上にご利用いただいており、韓国・シンガポール・米国・英国にも展開しています。
詳細はこちら: BoostDraft Company Deck
採用背景
BoostDraftはいま、APAC事業の成長に伴い、チームがこの1年で約1.5倍に拡大しています。プロダクトには確かな手応えがある一方、組織はまだ小さく、一人ひとりの仕事が会社全体に影響するフェーズです。
導入企業は800社を超え、利用のされ方も業種や部門ごとに多様化しています。この動きに伴い、既存のお客様企業内における複数部門への展開や新たな活用方法のご提案など、今まで以上に深くお客様が抱える課題と向き合う機会が増えてきました。
一方で、こうした機会に十分なリソースを割けているとは言えず、、お客様ごとに最適な活用方法を提案し、取引を広げていく体制はこれから強化していく段階にあります。そこで今回、既存のお客様を担当し、活用の定着から追加のご提案、契約までを一貫して担うメンバーを募集する運びとなりました。
想定業務
担当する既存のお客様について、導入後の活用定着から追加のご提案、契約の更新までを一貫して担っていただきます。担当アカウントの継続率と、アカウントあたりの取引額の拡大に責任を負うポジションです。担当するお客様が成果を出し、その結果として取引が広がっている状態をつくることを、このポジションのゴールとしています。
上記を実現するために、具体的には以下を担当いただきます。
顧客理解と関係構築：利用状況・業務課題の把握、現場のキーパーソンから決裁者までのリレーション構築

Are you an enterprise sales professional who treats business development as a craft, not just a numbers game? Do you want to move past transactional, inbound-dependent selling to open major accounts from scratch, taking full ownership of the sales narrative for an early-stage product where technical credibility and strategic context matter?
About JetBrains
We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

Enterprise software sales requires deep technical curiosity and real ownership, especially when introducing a completely new product category. AppGlass is our new AI-powered production debugging product designed to help engineering teams investigate complex issues directly within running applications. Because this is an early-stage product, we are building our enterprise pipeline from the ground up, moving past inherited inbound funnels to establish direct relationships with engineering leaders.
In this role, you will lead the full outbound enterprise sales execution for AppGlass across Europe. You will work independently to self-source opportunities, map complex organization structures, and gain access to senior technical decision-makers.

You will collaborate closely with our Product Lead to refine our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), funnel strategy, and product messaging based on real-world interactions.

You will own the entire commercial relationship – from initial discovery through security, procurement, and contract execution – directly influencing how our product scales in the global enterprise market.

Identify and reach relevant engineering decision-makers within target enterprise accounts.
Source your own sales pipeline through professional networking, targeted outreach, referrals, and industry events.
Lead comprehensive discovery sessions and commercial conversations with technical champions and economic buyers.
Drive enterprise pilot programs forward, ensuring clear alignment between user feedback and commercial goals.
Navigate complex security reviews, legal negotiations, procurement cycles, and vendor onboarding processes.
Negotiate and finalize B2B commercial agreements to secure new enterprise customers.
Deliver structured feedback from prospects to product teams to help continuously refine positioning and features.

A problem-solving mindset that enjoys turning early-stage product complexity into clear, structured business value.
The autonomy to drive enterprise deals independently and take full accountability for the revenue outcomes.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical engineering concepts intelligently with developers and financial realities with executives.
A commitment to building long-term trust with clients over securing quick, transactional wins.
Resilience and adaptability when navigating the ambiguous, evolving landscape of a new product launch.
What you’ll need
A proven track record of closing enterprise B2B sales for highly technical products, such as developer tools, observability, infrastructure, cloud, or security software.
The demonstrated capability to open major enterprise accounts from zero without relying on pre-existing inbound leads.
An established professional network among engineering leaders and senior technology executives.
Hands-on experience navigating complex enterprise procurement, legal frameworks, compliance hurdles, and information security evaluations.
Strong command of strategic outbound pipeline generation methodologies.
Fluency in written and spoken English for daily collaboration across international teams and client organizations.
What success looks like
Success means establishing predictable, scalable enterprise sales for AppGlass. You will earn the trust of the team by consistently securing qualified meetings with enterprise decision-makers and turning raw outreach into active, progressing pilot programs. You win when you navigate complex security and procurement hurdles smoothly, converting early-stage pilots into stable, long-term paid commercial agreements that validate our market positioning and drive sustainable revenue growth.

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution.

By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.
This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response.

Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

PadSplit is hiring for an Account Executive to expand our marketplace by engaging traditional property owners to become PadSplit Hosts. This role is critical in helping homeowners unlock additional income by listing their properties, while addressing housing affordability by creating more shared housing opportunities in the Chicago, Illinois market.

s.h: The Person We Are Looking For
s.t:
We are seeking a driven and personable Account Executive with experience in sales or real estate who excels at building relationships with property owners and real estate investors.

This role involves delivering a tailored value pitch on how the PadSplit model and technology consistently drive superior rental income compared to traditional single-family rentals.

The ideal candidate thrives in a remote environment, demonstrates strong communication skills, and wants to have an impact on the affordable housing crisis - one room at a time.

Prospect and Qualify Leads: Research and identify potential property owners who might be interested in becoming PadSplit Hosts and qualify them based on suitability.
Conduct Outreach: Execute outreach strategies, including cold calling, emailing, and networking, to connect with traditional property owners.
Host Discovery Calls and Meetings: Engage property owners in initial conversations to understand their needs, goals, and potential barriers to joining PadSplit.
Deliver Value Propositions : Clearly articulate the benefits of PadSplit's model, such as increased revenue potential, simplified management, and societal impact.
Build and Nurture Relationships: Develop trust-based relationships with property owners, acting as a trusted advisor to address concerns and highlight opportunities.
Tailor Solutions: Customize hosting solutions based on the unique circumstances of property owners, including financial modeling, property suitability, and compliance requirements.
Close Deals: Guide property owners through the decision-making process, negotiate terms, and finalize agreements for onboarding as PadSplit Hosts.
Collaborate with Onboarding Teams: Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding for new Hosts, providing accurate property details and expectations.
Track and Report Metrics: Maintain detailed records in CRM systems, tracking outreach activities, conversion rates, and other key performance indicators.
Stay Updated on Market Trends: Monitor the real estate market, competitive landscape, and legislative changes to refine outreach and value propositions effectively.
Host Educational Sessions: Organize webinars or in-person sessions to educate property owners on PadSplit’s benefits and address common misconceptions.

s.h: Here’s what you’ll need to be successful
s.t:
Sales Experience: Proven success in B2B or B2C sales, particularly in the real estate or property management sectors, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
Relationship-Building Skills: Strong interpersonal and communication abilities to build trust and long-term relationships with property owners.
Self-Motivation and Independence: High level of self-discipline and motivation to thrive in a remote, fast-paced startup environment with minimal supervision.
Adaptability and Problem-Solving: Ability to think on their feet, overcome objections, and tailor solutions to meet the unique needs of property owners.
Knowledge of Real Estate Markets: Familiarity with the dynamics of real estate investing, rental markets, and property management is highly desirable.
Tech Proficiency: Comfortable using CRM systems (we use Salesforce and Hubspot), sales enablement tools, and virtual communication platforms for outreach and reporting.
Strong Presentation Skills: Ability to confidently present PadSplit’s value proposition through virtual meetings, calls, or live presentations.
Analytical Skills: Capable of interpreting market data, calculating ROI, and presenting financial benefits to potential Hosts.
Team Collaboration: Effective at collaborating with cross-functional teams, such as marketing and onboarding, to ensure a seamless experience for new Hosts.
Entrepreneurial Mindset: Resilience and resourcefulness to tackle challenges and drive results in a rapidly changing startup environment.
PadSplit Core Values: Consistently demonstrate our values of compassionate directness, high integrity, optimism, intellectual curiosity, strong work ethic, empathy, self-awareness.

Deine Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, die Verkaufsstrategie für den technischen Verkauf weiterzuentwickeln und mit uns gemeinsam die Zukunft zu gestalten. Dabei stehen dir alle Möglichkeiten offen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und deine Fähigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln.
### Deine Aufgaben
* Technische neue Produkte: Du bearbeitest neue Anfragen, klärst Anforderungen und beurteilst gemeinsam mit unserem technischen Team die technische Machbarkeit und erarbeitest die kommerziellen Angebote bis zur Auftragsvergabe.
* Projektleitung: Du führst und motivierst das technische Projektteam bei neuen Kundenprojekten vom ersten Entwurf über Muster und Erstmuster bis zur erfolgreichen Serienauslieferung. Bei technischen oder terminlichen Herausforderungen koordinierst du die notwendigen Abklärungen, fasst konsequent nach und begleitest Lösungen bis zum Abschluss.
* Schnittstellenkoordination: Du arbeitest eng mit Technik, Produktion, Einkauf und unseren Produktionsstandorten zusammen und stellst einen reibungslosen Informationsfluss sicher.
* Kundenbetreuung: Du bist technische Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, baust bestehende Beziehungen weiter aus und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.
* Strategische Verkaufsplanung: Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Verkaufsstrategien zur Steigerung des Umsatzes und Marktanteils.
* Budget\- und Zielverantwortung: Erstellung und Kontrolle von Verkaufsbudgets, Sicherstellung der Erreichung von Umsatz\- und Profitzielen.
### Dein Profil
* Technische Grundausbildung von Vorteil, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF/FH oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Verkauf
* Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis und Freude daran, technische Lösungen gemeinsam mit Kunden und internen Fachstellen zu entwickeln
* Interesse am Verkauf und daran, dich im technischen Vertrieb weiterzuentwickeln
* Freude an Kundenkontakt, Projektarbeit und bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit
* Selbständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln
* Führungserfahrung ist nicht erforderlich, wichtiger sind für uns dein Potenzial, deine Motivation und deine Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
### Das bieten wir dir
Bei uns erwartet dich keine klassische Verkaufsstelle, bei der du vom ersten Tag an nur Umsatzzahlen hinterherläufst. Stattdessen erhältst du die Möglichkeit, unsere Produkte, Prozesse und Kunden von Grund auf kennenzulernen und dich Schritt für Schritt in eine verantwor\-tungsvolle Funktion im technischen Verkauf zu entwickeln.
Wir bieten dir viel Gestaltungsspielraum, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, deine technischen Kenntnisse mit Verkauf, Projektmanagement und später auch Führungsverantwortung zu verbinden.

PadSplit is hiring a Host Account Manager of Emerging Products to serve as the dedicated strategic partner and primary point of contact for a portfolio of PadSplit hosts. This is a newly created role at the heart of our Host Success model, designed to shift how we support all hosts from reactive problem-solving to proactive, relationship-driven account management.
You will own the full host relationship from activation through long-term retention. But owning the relationship means more than managing check-ins and reviewing dashboards.

It means being a trusted partner and the person your hosts call when something goes wrong, someone who knows the platform, the policies, and the fee structures well enough to provide clear answers on the spot.

You will be measured on the outcomes that matter most: your response times, occupancy performance, host satisfaction, churn reduction, and portfolio retention. This role is critical to ensuring every host in your book of business has what they need to thrive on the platform, and that they feel it.

s.h: The Person We Are Looking For
s.t:
We are looking for a relationship-first operator who leads with data, follows through with hustle, and knows the product, policies, and PadSplit member outcomes well enough to earn a host’s trust in the first conversation. You are proactive by nature, the kind of person who spots a problem in a dashboard before a host ever has to call about it.

You are also comfortable in the reactive moments: a confused host on the phone about a payout deduction, a complex situation involving a member that requires judgment and empathy in equal measure, a policy question that does not have a clean answer. You handle those moments with the same professionalism you bring to your scheduled portfolio reviews.
You understand that being a trusted partner requires genuine knowledge. You do not escalate everything, and you do not guess. You build the platform and policy fluency to be the person who actually resolves the issue, and you know when escalation is the right call. You believe in PadSplit’s mission and understand what it means to work in the affordable housing space, where the stakes for both hosts and members are real.

Own and manage a dedicated portfolio of PadSplit hosts, serving as their primary named point of contact for support ticket escalation and resolution, policy adherence and understanding, and overall portfolio direction
Provide the right information at the right time, becoming a partner and strategic advisor of PadSplit
Build proactive, trust-based relationships that reduce churn and increase host lifetime value.
Conduct regular performance check-ins, including structured reviews aligned to host goals and PadSplit benchmarks.
Drive host accountability on key metrics including attainable occupancy, bookability flags, rejection rates, move-in ratings, and member retention.
Partner with hosts on portfolio growth, including conversations about adding new properties and expanding their PadSplit footprint.
Serve as the host’s internal advocate, surfacing feedback and trends to product, operations, and leadership.

Maintain deep working knowledge of PadSplit’s platform, fee structures, payout mechanics, and host-facing policies, with the ability to explain decisions clearly and confidently.
Serve as a knowledgeable, trusted point of contact for hosts navigating financial questions, policy inquiries, and operational challenges.
Apply PadSplit policies thoughtfully, explaining both the “what” and the “why” in a way that builds understanding and trust rather than resentment.
Guide hosts on pricing strategy, occupancy optimization, listing quality, rejection rate management, and platform best practices using both data and platform knowledge.
Monitor host and property performance using PadSplit’s data tools, identifying risks and opportunities before they become problems.

Lead an intro call for every new host in your portfolio, establishing the relationship and setting expectations from day one.
Guide new hosts from the beginning, covering pricing, room standards, rejection rate drivers, and mission-critical success requirements.
Prepare hosts for their first members: responsiveness standards, room readiness expectations, and move-in experience requirements.
Educate new hosts on member outcome drivers including safety compliance, pricing discipline, and platform behaviors that directly improve member, host and company outcomes.

Navigate complex, nuanced host situations that require investigation, sound judgment, and fair resolution.
Escalate and coordinate resolution of issues that require cross-functional support, working with member support, trust and safety, payments, and legal teams where appropriate.
Manage emotionally charged conversations with empathy, composure, and directness, holding firm on policy while maintaining the relationship.
Document ticket details and resolutions accurately, maintaining clear records across all host interactions.
Identify patterns in host concerns and flag systemic issues to inform process, policy, or product improvements.

Contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, talk tracks, macro responses, and best practices as this function matures.
Participate in weekly team syncs to share what is working, surface friction points, and iterate on the program in real time.

s.h: Here’s What You’ll Need to Be Successful
s.t:
Account Management or Customer Success Background: 3+ years of account management, customer success, or high-touch client relationship experience. Background in real estate, property management, hospitality, or a platform-based marketplace is strongly preferred.
Platform and Policy Fluency: Ability and willingness to develop deep working knowledge of PadSplit’s product, fee structures, and policies, and to use that knowledge in live host conversations.
Proactive Portfolio Management: Proven ability to manage a large book of relationships with a proactive, not reactive, approach. You spot the problem before the host calls.
Data-Driven Communication: Comfortable using data to tell a story and drive a conversation. You can translate performance metrics into clear, actionable guidance a host can act on today.
Critical Thinking and Sound Judgment: Ability to analyze incomplete or conflicting information, apply policies thoughtfully in nuanced scenarios, and arrive at fair, defensible decisions.
Empathetic Directness: Skill in balancing compassion with clarity, especially when delivering difficult or unpopular outcomes. You hold firm on policy while making the host feel heard.
Strong Communication: Clear, confident written and verbal communication tailored to diverse audiences. You build trust quickly and handle difficult conversations without escalating unnecessarily.
Organization and Follow-Through: Highly organized with the ability to prioritize across a large portfolio without dropping the ball on high-value or high-risk relationships.
Mission Alignment: Genuine belief in PadSplit’s mission and an understanding of what it means to operate in the affordable housing space.
Growth Mindset: Motivated by the idea of building something new and improving it as you go. This function is being built from the ground up and you will help shape it.
